newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bodies of 15 India crash victims arrive in Saudi.
newsitem.headline: Bodies of 15 India crash victims arrive in Saudi.

text.p: The bodies of 14 crew members and one Saudi passenger of a Saudi jumbo jet involved in the world's worst mid-air collision were flown from India to Saudi Arabia on Friday.
"The plane carrying the 15 bodies...arrived in Jeddah tonight," a Saudi Arabian Airlines Corp spokesman said by telephone.

He said the bodies included 10 Saudi citizens: five flight crew members, four security guards and one passenger. The bodies of another five crew members also arrived: two Morrocans, one Jordanian, one Algerian, and one Tunisian.

A Saudi Arabian Airlines jumbo jet with 312 people on board and a KazAir Ilyushin IL-76 freighter carrying 37 collided on Tuesday, seven minutes after the Saudi plane took off from New Delhi. There were no survivors.
"The bodies of the other Saudi crew members have not been identified yet," added the spokesman in Jeddah. Twelve of the 23 crew members were Saudi citizens, five of them security men.
Officials earlier said there were 289 passengers on the Saudi flight: 230 Indians, 51 Nepalese, three Pakistanis, two Americans, one Briton, one Bangladeshi and one Saudi national.
